title.narrative: IGAD: Regional Refugee management phase II

description.narrative: Stödet för IGAD:s andra fas kommer att bygga på de framsteg som gjorts i den första fasen, särskilt vad gäller utvecklingen, valideringen och godkännandet av IGAD:s policyramverk för flyktingskydd. Den andra fasens stöd kommer att fokusera på genomförandet av policyramverket med ett djupare samarbete med flyktingar, flyktingledda och kvinnoledda organisationer. Programmet kommer att tillhandahålla tekniskt stöd till medlemsstaterna i syfte att anpassa och harmonisera nationella strategier med det regionala policyramverket, samt stärka skyddsresponsen för flyktingar i regionen. Dessutom kommer programmet att stärka IGAD-medlemsstaternas kapacitet i processer för fastställande av flyktingstatus samt öka effektiviteten i dessa processer. 'Gender Equality' är markerat som ett viktigt mål för detta program, eftersom programmet kommer att genomföra en genusanalys och erbjuda utbildning till medlemsstaterna vad gäller olika genusaspekter i policyutveckling samt tillhandahålla tekniskt stöd för att integrera genuskänsliga element i flyktinghanteringspolicyers och strategier. Dessutom syftar programmet till att öka kvinnors och kvinnoledda organisationers deltagande i diskussioner om policyförändringar med beslutsfattare på nationell och subnationell nivå.

The IGAD second phase support will build on the progress made in the first phase support, specifically the development, validation, and endorsement of the IGAD Policy Framework on Refugee Protection. The second phase support will focus on the implementation of the policy framework with more engagement of refugees, refugee-led and women-led organizations. The program will provide technical assistance to MS to align national policies to the regional Policy framework, facilitating the harmonization of policies in the region as well as improving the refugee protection space in the region. Moreover, the program will strengthen the capacity of IGAD Member States in Refugee Status Determination (RSD) processes and aim to increase efficiency in these processes.
The program has marked 'Gender Equality' as a significant objective as the program will conduct a gender analysis, and provide technical assistance to Member States to revise national refugee management policies with gender considerations.
Furthermore, the program aims to enhance the participation of women and women-led organizations in policy change discussions with policy makers.

sector.narrative: Facilitation of orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility

description.narrative:
Progress report has not yet been received for the first reporting period. However, IGAD has communicated some of the following activities and results achieved during a meeting, and the Embassy in Addis Ababa has also participated on one of the events-launch of a refugee engagement forum:
1. Established and launched the Regional Refugee Engagement Forum (RREF) in November 2024, this forum will aim to expand the network between Refugees, and Refugee Led Organizations (RLOs) and other development actors in the region, creating opportunities for enhancing the capacity of RLOs and refugee leaders in advocacy and resource mobilization efforts. Furthermore, the platform will create opportunities for Refugees and MS to discuss challenges on the ground, and engage in policy discussions.
2. Provided support to improve data collection and analysis capabilities within national technical working groups on Migration and displacement statistics for Djibouti.
3. Strengthened capacities of Djiboutis national Refugee Status Determination (RSD) officers, promoting consistency and compliance with international standards and processes. Done in collaboration with UNHCR Djibouti.
4. Conducted institutional capacity needs assessment of MS, an assessment to identify and address institutional capacity gaps in refugee protection and migration management.
5. Analysis in progress to identify critical gender gaps in the region, particularly in protection for refugee women, leading to the integration of gender-responsive measures in program implementation.
6. Conducted orientation and training on the RREF; training in partnership with UNHCR, and Oxfam was provided to refugee representatives from each of the MS (with the exception of Ethiopia who had challenges with travelling). The training was on meaningful refugee engagement, advocacy, and resource mobilization, as well as in the the provisions of the IGAD Policy Framework on Refugee protection. 25 participants that are refugee leaders and from RLOs participated in this training.
7. Program identified 200,000 backlogs on Refugee Status Determination (RSD) processes in Kenya. Training was provided to refugee management institutions in Kenya, 26 participants attended, and the training is expected to support Kenya with efficient processes that will allow them to clear out the backlogs.
8. IGAD in the process of validating the results monitoring framework, the IGAD support platform M&E framework has been revised by adding protection indicators. IGAD plans to use this M&E framework to track the implementation of the IGAD Policy Framework on Refugee Protection
